lead.caption: Bombers over the strait: Qeshm Island's missile site — the first of the day's three Gulf flashpoints.
lead.deck: US jets struck a Revolutionary Guard missile site on Qeshm Island after Iran's third drone attack in a week on a US radar station in Bahrain. Tehran answered within hours: drones hit Kuwait's Patriot batteries and the Ali Al Salem air base. A tanker was struck in the strait, a crewman is missing, and oil's slide stopped dead at the Hormuz risk.
lead.headline: AMERICA BOMBS IRAN'S QESHM MISSILE SITE; TEHRAN ANSWERS IN BAHRAIN AND KUWAIT
